lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Young Lady Marian,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: canst thou accomplish it?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: If it pleaseth thee not, I shall not compel thee.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: To be honest, I don't want to.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I don't want to see anyone die, be it Raptures or any of you.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I don't want to have to kill Raptures.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: But...
Marian stares straight at Nayuta.
Her eyes are still glazed with sorrow, tear streaks etched down her cheeks.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... I shouldn't be saying something like this to you, Nayuta.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Those clones of yours aren't just mechanical robots, are they?

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: They're... living beings, right?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, it doth depend upon how one doth define life itself...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Yet, in the common conceit, thou may'st so say.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I'll do it.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Everyone's out there fighting, putting everything on the line.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I'll do the same.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: I'll give it my all.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Fall...!
The giant rains bullets and missiles down on the Queen's space station.
Stripped of its weaponry, the station is left utterly defenseless, unable to do anything but endure the barrage.
A thunderous explosion tears through it, and its shattered components come falling down like deadly hail.
Countless Raptures are obliterated beneath the crashing wreckage.
The giant pulls back, then deploys the particle cannon mounted on her shoulder.
Light begins to pool inside the barrel, quickly reaching critical mass. The air ripples as particles quiver on the brink of release.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Fall...!

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: It is you who shall fall.
Having taken the form of a gigantic centipede, Indivilia unleashes a bolt of lightning
that tears through the sky, stretching toward the giant's body.
In an instant, Marian's massive body vanishes, as if it had never been there in the first place.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: What is this...?!
Without warning, Marian's massive form appears behind the Queen's space station.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Particle disassembly and reassembly...?

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: So you've forsaken both your humanity and Rapture selves alike, you incomplete abomination!

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Faaaaall!
The particle cannon emits a blast of light.
It pierces through the station,
then skims across the ground.
Raptures caught in its path shatter and melt under the searing beam.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Curse it...!
The giant centipede swings its tail with crushing force.
Marian's body reels from the blow, her stance faltering.
In a flash, the giant centipede coils its long body around her frame,
then unleashes a violent surge of electricity.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Urrrggh...!

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: I shall either roast you as you stand or crush you outright!

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Your Queen has fallen, and yet you still linger in the air.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Truly, a most disloyal servant.
A battered Harran plummets from above and lands atop the giant centipede's head.
Without the slightest hesitation, she drives her scythe into the centipede's forehead.
Then, a surge of lightning lashes out, racing along the blade.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Now it's your turn to fall.
Black powder erupts like an explosion.
The giant centipede's body rusts away in an instant,
crumbling as if weathered by centuries.
At the same time, rust begins to spread across Harran's body.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Can my immunity not keep up anymore?

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Johan... my Commander.

lines.speaker: johan_op_c
lines.text: I'm listening.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Have we completed our mission, then?

lines.speaker: johan_op_c
lines.text: Mission complete, Inherit.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I'm glad to hear it.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I know it may be greedy of me,

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: but for the first and last time, would you bestow upon us that glorious title?

lines.speaker: johan_op_c
lines.text: Well done,

lines.speaker: johan_op_c
lines.text: Goddesses of Victory.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Heh...

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: How... wonderful it is... to hear...

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Follower... I leave the rest...
Harran crumbles into dust and vanishes.
In the next moment, nothing remains.
At the same time, the giant centipede also disintegrates.
Freed from the armor that was the centipede, Indivilia begins to fall.
As she does, she gazes up at the sky—
the exploding space station, the falling Queen,
and the giant Marian tearing through the Raptures with relentless fury.
For the first time in this battle, the notion of defeat enters Indivilia's mind.
Elsewhere, Chime drives Trombe at full speed across the battlefield.
Thunderous crashes and blinding flashes erupt behind her, but she never once looks back.
Clinging desperately to what remains of Crown's tattered upper body in the seat ahead, she presses the ruined form close.
It seems impossible to hold on, yet Chime refuses to let go.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Your Highness! I pray thee, hold on... but a little longer!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: We shall anon reach where Rapunzel dwelleth!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Chi... me... *Cough*

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Aye! Aye, Your Highness! I am listening!
Crown grabs Chime's hand.
Feeling the lack of strength in Crown's grasp, Chime struggles to hold back the sobs threatening to spill.
Meanwhile, Trombe presses onward.
Not far ahead, Snow White, Scarlet, and Rapunzel come into view.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: W-we are nigh there, Your Highness!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Just a little more, pray endure a moment longer...!
Suddenly, Chime remembers the conversation she had with them before charging in.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: White Snow, Young Lady Scarlet, and Persinette, pray remain as far removed from the battlefield as ye may.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Are you saying we're supposed to just sit back until then?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: We've already given up on defending Eden. Now that the shield's down, there's no reason for us not to be sent in...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis for naught else but to face the Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... This may well become a war of attrition. Grievous losses shall we endure,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: yet the Queen is fated to fall unto the surface.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Naught know we of her true capabilities.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thus, none but ye three may confront her.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I beseech thee, preserve thy strength until that appointed hour.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Are we then to do naught but stand idle and behold?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... So it is.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: How can we do that when everyone is out there risking their lives?!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: You have greater matters to attend to.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Leave the lesser ones to us.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: See to it that the Queen is defeated.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Had the Naked King been fully charged, it would have sufficed for Her Highness alone...

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: but 'tis as it is, so I shall yield for now.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: See that thou triumphest.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I trust in thee.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Without fail.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Chi... me...
Crown tightens her grip on Chime's hand,
with all the strength she can muster.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I unde... I understand, Your Highness.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: ... Chime, here.
T.A.L.O.S. produces some camouflage tarp from its backpack.
Chime takes it and covers Crown's torso.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: My... thanks.
Trombe skids to a halt before the Pioneers.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: ... Good grief, what an easy life you've got.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: The Queen hath fallen. Go on, fetch her head at once.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: We will.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: 'Tis about time we toddle off.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: ... Is Crown all right?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Ah, worry not. She hath merely gone to cool herself after exerting far too much.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Linger not, lest Her Highness return and take the Queen's head herself! If thou wouldst keep thy glory, make haste, I say.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: That shall not do. Let us make haste.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Righty-o, off with thee!

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: We'll be back.
Snow White, Scarlet, and Rapunzel move forward,
crouching low as they run.
Chime watches them and shouts loudly.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Thou...! Must win...!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Absolutely! Absolutely! Absolutely must win!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Dost thou hear meee?!
Snow White gives a thumbs up.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Let us go to Eden! I shall make use of the infirmary!

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Got it!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, I shall take a look.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Nayuta...!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Though I may possess not Persinette's skill in the healing arts,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I can tend to urgent wounds and see her safely borne to Eden.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: ... Your Highness.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Do not... worry.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: ... Very well, it is.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Though combat be not my forte, I shall return anon, and smite at least one Rapture's head myself, I swear.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: He... re...
Crown extends her hand toward Chime,
who reaches out and takes what is offered.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: This... may be...

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: lacking... but... just this once...

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: N-no, I can't, Your Highness! How could I ever dare...!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Because it's you... you can.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Chime, you are... my aide... and the finest... in all of Crown Kingdom...

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: *Cough*

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: V-very well. I shall try.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: ... No! I shall accomplish it!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: I believe in you, Chime.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Right!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Kilo! Away we go!

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: ... Yes!

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: You're Nayuta, right?

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Please take good care of Crown.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: She's the one who showed me where I truly belong... and someone really precious to me.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: I'm counting on you!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Understood. I shall see to it mineself that she liveth, verily.
Chime, Kilo, and T.A.L.O.S. nod and dash onto the battlefield without a moment's hesitation.
Meanwhile, Nayuta watches them quietly.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Now then, Young Lady Crown, pray endure but a little longer.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: This humble one shall exert all mine utmost strength to grasp thy thread of life.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Nayu... ta.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Why do you... merely stand and watch?

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Why... do you not run out to join them?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Pray, refrain from discourse. I must needs devote myself wholly to thy treatment.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Are you... afraid?

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: You know so much... yet you cannot decide.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Is that why you keep... keep... standing by?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, I am beset with fear. To know more than others doth not ever bring advantage.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should matters go awry... I do fear the fault shall rest upon me.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Therefore... I am unable to decide.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Hmm... how clever... of you.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... So it would seem.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Nayu... ta...

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Merely standing by and watching... won't change... a thing.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, I am aware.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: *Huff...! Huff...!*
Papillon sprints across the surface,
constantly checking the safe route displayed on her phone.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: *Huff...! Huff...!*
The safe route Isabel gave her has proven reliable. She hasn't run into a single Rapture so far.
At this pace, she's confident she'll make it to the Ark without incident.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Hah...! Haha...! Ahahaha...!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Hahahahahaha!
Papillon laughs.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Hahaha! Those idiots...!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Those lunatics...!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I show them a little kindness, and they're ready to give me everything... Haha!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Honestly, it's almost too easy!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: I knew it...! Lady Luck's on my side!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Hahahaha!
